# SAP Business One — vendor facts

Checked 24 Sept 2026. [OFF] official, [THIRD] third-party, [NF] not found.

- Prices: not published ("Request a quote") [OFF] — https://www.sap.com/france/products/erp/business-one.html. Figures around 91 €/month (Professional) are [THIRD].
- Channel: resellers (VARs) [THIRD]; deployment on-premise or partner cloud [THIRD].
- Maintenance [OFF] — https://support.sap.com/en/offerings-programs/support-small-medium-enterprises/business-one/maintenance.html: 9.x mainstream maintenance ended; **10.0 mainstream maintenance until 31 Dec 2028** (third-party sites saying 2026 are wrong); "at least five (5) years" of mainstream maintenance; "Extended maintenance is not offered". Feature packs since 10.0.
- Upgrades [OFF]: direct upgrade only between consecutive releases — https://support.sap.com/en/offerings-programs/support-small-medium-enterprises/business-one/upgrades-patches.html. From 9.2/9.3: via 10.0 FP 2208 then SP 2402 [THIRD].
- Customisation [OFF]: SDK — DI API, UI API, Service Layer (OData v4 preferred since FP 2405).
- France e-invoicing: SAP SE is a PA (listed 15 Jan 2026); Business One relies on SAP DRC Cloud Edition (subscription), described as under development in an SAP Community post [OFF, excerpt only]. **Verify the status for your version.**

## Quote traps
- Multi-step upgrade path hidden behind "upgrade to latest"; add-ons (partner solutions) not certified for the target; DRC subscription for e-invoicing not priced; licences by type (Professional, Limited, Starter) not itemised.
